tips.text: Run all six Hex bounties on Steel Path every day; one bounty with each member also earns their daily chemistry.
Push KIM chats, gifts and a daily bounty with each member early so Rank 4 is not waiting on Liked chemistry.
Bank your Hex Treasures for the Rank 3 and Rank 5 sacrifices; On-lyne CDs are the one players run short on.
Bring Parallax air support to ping Hex Treasures; loot radar, Orokin Eye or a wide-range Xaku or Limbo also sweep a tile fast.
Hold Big Bytes Pizza and Argon Burger Meals and turn them in on days you cannot play, even from the mobile app.
Abort and reroll a bounty whose objective can soft-lock you solo, like vehicle-destroy counts or tank kills.
Wait for Mastery Rank 14 before buying the part blueprints; the main blueprint is rank-locked.
Players call the Hex the gentlest syndicate climb; the daily cap is the only real limit.
